content.short: Coinflow simplifies payments for businesses by enabling global card acceptance and instant customer payouts.
content.description: Coinflow provides a payment solution for web3 companies to accept traditional payment methods and to settle customer payouts by converting cryptocurrency into USD for transfer into their standard bank accounts. Its core use case is to onboard non-crypto-native users, such as gamers and wallet users, by offering familiar payment flows, while the platform manages the complex infrastructure in the background.
content.meta: Coinflow is a payment solution for web3 companies enabling payments and USD payouts. Discover Coinflow and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
